title: Where every number comes from
lede: SEC filings are cited by accession number and were retrieved from EDGAR in October 2026. Press items are cited as published. Links open in a new tab.

notes.label: Note
notes.text: Sales per store, the 2011–2013 gross margins and advertising as a share of sales are our calculations from reported totals.

notes.label: Note
notes.text: 1995–1998 sales and earnings are Tandy Corporation’s, which still included other chains, so they aren’t comparable with later years.

notes.label: Note
notes.text: The 2013 10-K restated 2009–2012 sales. We use the restated figures for those years and first-reported figures before 2009.

notes.label: Note
notes.text: We don’t have a sourced share price for 2014, or a reliable count of RadioShack-branded stores after April 2015.

notes.label: Note
notes.text: Facts about rivals marked “general knowledge” and the TRS-80’s launch year are not from the sources listed here.

notes.label: Note
notes.text: Weights in the cause-of-death section and all what-if text are editorial judgment.
